title: Vinyl
summary: A music player: MP3, FLAC, Vorbis, Opus, WAV, AAC; wired and Bluetooth.
description: Plays the music in ~/Music and on USB drives, folder by folder or from M3U playlists: gapless, shuffle, repeat, cover art, resume where you stopped. Plays on while you use other apps. Wired outputs, and Bluetooth headsets and speakers on boards with a sound server; headset and keyboard play keys. AAC, ALAC, WMA and more need the FFmpeg libraries. Needs a screen of 480x320 or more.
depends: libstdc++6, libgcc-s1, libfreetype6, libinput10, libxkbcommon0, libasound2t64 | libasound2, libmpg123-0t64 | libmpg123-0, libvorbisfile3, libflac14 | libflac12t64 | libflac12, libopus0, libpulse0
recommends: libavformat61 | libavformat62, libavcodec61 | libavcodec62, libavutil59 | libavutil60, libswresample5 | libswresample6
